ratings.comment: Bill is extremely talkative and seems to love the sound of his voice. He seems to know a lot about real estate, but he is not great at helping you understand. Some great players make terrible coaches mostly due to how naturally things come to them, Bill is like one of those players. Expect to devote many hours to each problem set.

Bill is a great professor. This is a tough course and you have to work at it, but if you are willing to succeed, he will help you get there. Go to his office hours and get to know him! He is very knowledgeable and cares about his students. Participation counts, there are 3 exams, problem sets that take a long time to complete, and a case study.

Hardest real estate class so far. Attendance and participation are mandatory. We were not given any feedback on our assignments, so we didn't know what we did wrong, and they weren't graded before the exams. The lectures are boring, and the three exams are terribly difficult. He is very accessible after class and loves talking about himself.

The review below is spot on. Decent guy, probs great in the field of CRE, but a very, very bad professor. He teaches in a way in which you feel like you should already know what he's talking about because be goes so fast and with such complexity. You'll probably get a decent grade (he curves hard), but if u want to get the content, take some1 else.

He glosses over the math, which is the bulk of the quizzes and exams. He explains the concepts well, but you have to spend time learning the applications of what he teaches you. The homework is optional, but you need it to do well on quizzes and exams. To do the homework, you'll have to dive deep into the material, which he doesn't do in class.

Bill runs through difficult material way too quickly. I feel like I did much more memorization than actually learning the material. He's a tough guy, would recommend any other professor. I would like to say I learned a lot due to the amount of time I spent on the course, but that would be untrue.

Bill is amazing and super knowledgeable on real estate. The class itself is difficult. Quizzes are not easy, group project requires a lot of effort and the final was awful 
The class gets curved. Be prepared to study and do a lot of homeworks to be prepared for the exams
The class at least in the spring semester 2022 has been curved a lot (5%/6%)

Get ready to spend hours with problem sets. He never actually taught the class. Would spend the entire class with a PowerPoint then ask if we had any questions with honwowrk. I remember him getting stuck for the entire review period. TeSts were awful and unnecessarily difficult.

Bill is really knowledgeable about the CRE and is a good lecturer. However, hw load can be at times absurd for 3 credits. I'm talking 15 lengthy book problems, 2 pg paper, + Excel work in one week. Test/Quizzes: For some reason, he really likes changing the wording on problems to try to purposefully confuse you. This class just idk: annoying....
